name: FieldWorkArena
description: FieldWorkArena is a benchmark designed for agentic AI to evaluate performance in real-world field work tasks, including monitoring and reporting safety, health, and manufacturing incidents in complex work environments. It features a new action space for agentic AI and improved evaluation functions, using multimodal data such as videos and documents collected from factories and warehouses.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with little to no established community adoption yet.
notes: Dataset includes videos and documents from real factories and warehouses; evaluation considers characteristics of multimodal LLMs like GPT-4o.
